propositions: The bridge status must be queried from durable git refs (last-pass and lock) rather than ephemeral runner directories to ensure CI reports actual production state
The old `bridge-status` spelling must remain executable as a compatibility alias that delegates to the same durable `bridge status` implementation without command breakage
Hard reconciler failures must be recorded durably despite GHA skipping the commit-back step when the reconciler step fails
Crashed vs. running state must be determined from the lock's fence progress across one lease, not from clock comparison against heartbeat_ns
The canary must consume bridge status via the CLI instead of querying the GitHub Actions API directly, and escalate via ticket creation on schedule
Local developer runs must not be reported as production status; status must stamp and filter by the configured REBAR_ENV_ID, never the gitignored .env-id
